dogecoin.text:
ck-#doge is an example of an on-chain integration with the @dogecoin network on #ICP.

Built by the @ICPandaDAO team, it is modeled after the current Bitcoin integration on ICP. 

Check it out 👇
https://t.co/RHmoSjW5hb
Note: the #dogecoin integration would be native, similar to  the already existing #bitcoin integration.

🚨The cross-chain team of @DFINITY needs your feedback:

Would you like to see a native #Dogecoin integration on #ICP or is there any other chain you would like to integrate with in your dapp?

What are the use cases and why do you need it?

Let us know!👇
